title: Adopt the protocol and ecosystem governance charter
summary: Adopt charter 1.0.0-rc.1: a protocol council, security response team, and appeals panel with seats reserved for independent implementers and community operators; published timelines for proposals, security decisions, appeals, and deprecation; conflict and funding disclosures linked to every decision; and rights that no plan, token, or funder can remove.
note: The charter sets its own adoption review at the 30-day breaking-change minimum. It cannot be decided while the council has no independent-implementer or community-operator seat holder, because the quorum requires both.
